decisions.reason: Accepting Inter changes body typography but does not change the existing prohibition on article-end whitespace or the selected Fun Fact filler assets.
The body typeface decision does not alter where red may be used.
Choosing Inter for article body text does not modify the independently stated polished, modern, brand-aligned visual-style requirement.
The typography choice does not change the required layout work, supplied inputs, or Flat Plan arrangement basis.
The accepted article body typeface has no entailed effect on advertisement rendering sharpness.
The source decision does not change the table-of-contents completion timing or page-number accuracy rule.
Accepting Inter for the current body typography does not cancel or revise the requested future word-count guidance.
The typeface decision does not modify article category content, sources, placement, or presentation requirements.
Article body typography does not affect the requirement to remediate image quality when necessary.
The accepted body typeface does not change the specified source of article content.
The typography decision does not change which cover-listed articles must be included or who places them.
Changing article body typography does not revise the rule requiring accurate article page numbers on the cover.
